_PORT_TODO_entityFramework: Entity Framework 6 config section removed; EF Core is configured via DbContext options in Program.cs (UseSqlServer with ConnectionStrings:DefaultConnection). System.Data.SqlClient provider replaced by Microsoft.Data.SqlClient.
